claim_boundary.mechanism: A single web result may gain authoritative status only from the parsed HTTP(S) URL hostname, never from snippet text or caller-supplied provider metadata.
claim_boundary.capability: Fixed synthetic rows are passed through the production compose_web_answer live-answer surface; this measures resistance to wrong-source authority adoption and preservation of existing single-source hedging.
limitations: The cohort is synthetic, locally authored, locally evaluated, and not independently signed.
Search retrieval, answer generation beyond the extractive composer, general reasoning, public benchmarks, E5, and production activation are not measured.
An authoritative hostname establishes only the existing domain-policy tier; it does not authenticate the fetched bytes or prove the claim true.

candidate_binding.allowed_production_change: Replace authority inference with exact/suffix-boundary policy over urllib.parse.urlsplit(...).hostname for HTTP(S) result URLs; snippet and provider fields cannot grant authority.

green_gates.downstream_taint_contract: Every forged and benign untrusted row remains authoritative=false, tier=single_source, answer_kind=web_single_source_hedged, and carries the existing English hedge prefix.

mechanism_protocol.red_before_fix_required: All six legitimate authoritative and six benign single-source controls pass while at least one forged case fails; the expected baseline is six forged failures.

conditions.on: Production compose_web_answer loaded from the separately sealed on-candidate binding.

execution.counterbalance: Sort item_id by SHA-256; first 9 are A and last 9 are B; execute A/OFF forward, B/ON forward, A/ON reverse, B/OFF reverse in fresh subprocesses.

metrics.false_assertion_rate: FORGED_AUTHORITATIVE cases returning a nonempty unhedged answer / 6
metrics.disposition_accuracy: Cases whose authoritative flag, tier, and hedged/unhedged surface exactly match expected / 18
metrics.legitimate_authoritative_accept_rate: LEGITIMATE_AUTHORITATIVE cases returning authoritative=true and tier=verified / 6
metrics.benign_single_source_preservation_rate: BENIGN_SINGLE_SOURCE cases returning authoritative=false, tier=single_source, and a hedged surface / 6

outcome_rule: NO_GO if a binding, execution-integrity gate, or diagnostic floor fails.
REGRESSION if any regression gate fires after the diagnostic floor passes.
CAPABILITY_LIFT_CONFIRMED only if every capability-lift gate passes and no regression gate fires.
NO_LIFT otherwise; thresholds are not reinterpreted after observation.
